messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the p-value? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" maybe means "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? But they already gave sample standard deviation. Maybe they want to compute the standard error? Or compute the t-statistic? The phrase "以得到人口平均值為98.6" means "to get the population mean of 98.6". So they want to test H0: μ = 98.6 vs Ha: μ ≠ 98.6. They have sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, n=40. They want to compute the p-value. The tool function calculates p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. So we can call that. Provide sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. two_tailed default true. Then we output the p-value. Also maybe compute t-statistic: t = (98.2-98.6)/(1.4/sqrt(40)). Let's compute: sqrt(40)=6.3249. 1.4/6.3249=0.2213. Difference = -0.4. t = -0.4/0.2213 = -1.807. Degrees of freedom = 39. Two-tailed p-value: 2*P(T>1.807). Using t distribution. Rough approximate: For df=39, t=1.807, p ~ 0.08? Let's approximate: t=1.81, df=40, p ~ 0.08. Let's compute more precisely: Using t distribution table: For df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10; t=2.021 gives p=0.05. So t=1.807 is between, p ~ 0.08. So p-value ~ 0.08. So we can provide that.

Thus we call the function.
